title: Human Recognition AI
description:
Real-time computer vision through a regular webcam. Three frameworks in one tool — switch modes without restarting:

1 — face mesh (468 points), 2 — hand tracking, 3 — body pose,
4 — all of MediaPipe at once, 5 — YOLO object detection,
6 — full mode, 7 — DeepFace: identifying people from a photo database.

To recognize known faces, just create a faces_db/ folder with subfolders named after each person.
